model_identity_and_settings.visible_role_description: Developer text describes the assistant as Codex, based on GPT-6; this is a role description, not independently verified runtime identity.

diagnostic_judgments: The case statement that group members failed to respond is a source example, not a manuscript limitation to relocate.
Final may and likelihood are different semantic levels; the repeated Chinese possibility token is required for fidelity.
check_prose flags are reference cues, not translation quality certification; its citation regex misses the Lardner citation with page number.

not_applicable.check_consistency.py: A four-paragraph single-section translation, not a multi-section or complete manuscript; local term and clause consistency checked in AI self-review.

encoding_incident: Initial PowerShell-to-Python source pipe replaced Chinese with question marks. Restored rationale and first draft with explicit UTF-8 .NET writes before semantic review; reran both first-draft scripts. Original invalid diagnostics retained under encoding-failure.*.
limitations: No independent source-article, cited-work, license, or canonical Chinese terminology verification; all attribution and source claims come from supplied material.
Review is AI self-review, not expert certification.
